## REQ-LOC-001

**Field of the Locale DataSet**

The Payload of a Locale DataSetMessage contains the field Locale, a String with an OPC UA LocaleId (e.g. "en-US", "de-DE"); no other field. The field is Mandatory.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Condition: The NetworkMessage carries a Locale.
- Scope: MG 8.2.7
- Refs: MG 8.3.12, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.12-df40f20c

## REQ-LOC-002

**A Get with Locale is answered in the requested language**

A Get may carry a Locale. If the responder supports localization and the requested locale, it publishes all LocalizedText elements of the answer (with the ReplyTo of the Get) in the requested locale, otherwise in the default language English (en-US). A Locale is only meaningful with the method Get; in a NetworkMessage of another method it is ignored by the receiver.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester, responder
- Condition: The Get carries a Locale.
- Scope: MG 8.2.7
- Refs: MG 8.3.12, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.12-5a01c78c, MG-8.3.12-af07feb7, MG-8.3.12-af922472, MG-8.3.12-f857d6fc

> If an application supports localization and the requested language is implemented in the application, the following Pub message, containing the ReplyTo of the Get message, must provide all LocalizedText elements in the requested language.
> — MG 8.3.12

> Otherwise, the LocalizedText elements must be provided in the default language English (en-US).
> — MG 8.3.12

> The DataSetMessage with Locale information is only meaningful in combination with the method Get; in a NetworkMessage of another method it is ignored by the receiver.
> — MG 8.3.12

> The information is provided via the method Get and can be combined with any Resource, which might have LocalizedText elements in it.
> — MG 8.3.12
